title: NIKE, Inc. Product Graphics Design Internship
note: Apparel graphics internship for final-year Graphic Design, Apparel Design or Product Design students graduating in 2027; includes relocation assistance.

facts.summary: Paid 10-week internship creating seasonal graphics for Nike sports apparel and uniforms at the Beaverton campus.
facts.duties: Concept and sketch product graphics, pick trims and print applications, work with development on production details, build visual narratives for uniform design.
facts.requirements: Final-year student graduating Spring–Winter 2027 in graphic, apparel or product design or related; portfolio of 3–5 product-graphics projects; typography, illustration, print/pattern, color and layout skills; Adobe CC.
facts.apply: Apply online through Nike's Workday careers posting with portfolio.
